name: Octopi
notes: Fixes from a live morning with 0.21.0: Salesforce says plainly when it needs a Due Date (and a task with no date is dated today when Salesforce requires one); a value that starts one option is that option ("Dormant"); a company is never answered "not found" because it was read as a person; a LinkedIn invitation that times out is retried and says whether Send was pressed. New: "Always allow changes" per CRM, and copy and paste with the keyboard in the chat.
